purpose: Second bounded excitatory campaign: the 2^3 matrix over F1, F2, F4 on the S+F3+F5 base, judged per group against the approved contract. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-06-h01-progressive-search-plan.md.
holdout: Sweep 53 is not on disk and not an input of any stage.
evaluation: One parameter set at both calibration sweeps.

A.title: Remaining six cells of the F1 x F2 x F4 matrix on the F3+F5 base
A.prediction: F1 and F2 move recovery minima toward zero (about +2.7 and +2.1 mV from the base), F4 away (-2.3 mV). F2 carries most of interval 2 (+27 of the candidate's +51.6 ms), F1 about +5 ms, F4 about +1.6 ms. Cell 110 has the best minima with interval 2 near +30 ms; cell 101 the best interval 2 with minima near -3 mV. No cell passes the 1 mV minima rows and the 1 ms crossing rows together. Any cell with an event count other than five is an exact failure and its supersets are skipped.
A.rejection: A cell passes only if every event, crossing, phase, minimum, and subthreshold row is within its allowance at both sweeps. If no cell passes both groups, Stage B doses the member with the largest minimum-per-interval ratio.
A.unchanged: Allen 541563728 geometry and mechanisms, recorded command and bias, nseg x9, CVode 1e-10, stop 2140 ms, library kv3-closing-source.

B.title: Dose split of the member with the best minimum-per-interval ratio
B.prediction: Defined in stage-a-decision.json before the runs (predicted F1 at opening factors 1.5 and 3.0 on cell 100, then F2 closing 0.95 and 0.8).
B.rejection: If the change in minimum per change in interval 2 is dose-invariant, no dose of F1, F2, or F4 passes both groups; a sub-system outside F1-F5 is required and the campaign reports FAIL.

C.title: Finalist tolerance recheck at CVode 1e-11
C.prediction: Every ranked row changes by less than its decision limit.
C.rejection: A row that moves more than its limit returns to noise.

fail_rule: No cell or dose meets every row at both sweeps by the cap: report FAIL and the sub-system outside F1-F5 that the residual pattern names.
budget_note: Stage A: 6. Stage B: 4 = 10. Stage C: 2 = 12. 12 in reserve.
